name: faithgpt
description: Scripture-grounded Bible study, devotionals, and doctrine review. Every verse is fetched from FaithGPT's Bible database instead of recalled from memory, so quotations are real and correctly attributed.

default_translation.title: Default Bible translation
default_translation.description: Translation used when you do not name one. FaithGPT serves KJV, ASV, and YLT.

verify_scripture_on_write.title: Flag Bible references when writing files
verify_scripture_on_write.description: After a file is written or edited, detect Bible references in it and remind the agent to verify them against the FaithGPT Bible database. Off by default.
